test_slurm_pipeline_executor: test SlurmPipelineExecutor by writing parquet shards to a bucket and reading them back
test_parquet_writer: test ParquetWriter to write Document objects as parquet shards to an hf://bucket URL
test_parquet_reader: test ParquetReader to read parquet shards from a bucket and reconstruct Document objects
test_hf_filesystem: test HfFileSystem to list parquet shards written to a bucket and verify shard count
test_slurm_pipeline_cli: test the CLI by running the script with --bucket and --partition arguments to submit a Slurm job
